verdicts.title: On automorphism groups of affine surfaces
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: This is a survey on the automorphism groups in various classes of affine algebraic surfaces and the algebraic group actions on such surfaces. Being infinite-dimensional, these automorphism groups share some important features of algebraic groups. verdicts.title: The Automorphism groups of zero-dimensional monomial algebras
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: A monomial algebra B is defined as a quotient of a polynomial ring by a monomial ideal, which is an ideal generated by a finite set of monomials. verdicts.title: On Automorphisms of Finite $p$-groups
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Let $G$ be a finite $p$-group such that $x\Z(G) \subseteq x^G$ for all $x \in G- \Z(G)$, where $x^G$ denotes the conjugacy class of $x$ in $G$. Then $|G|$ divides $|\Aut(G)|$, where $\Aut(G)$ is the group of all automorphisms of $G$.
